summaries.summary: The Printers class is a SmartFlow-based iOS automation page object that manages printer discovery, setup, and management workflows. It implements comprehensive printer operations including adding printers, searching by serial number, viewing printer information (name, model, location, status, supplies), and performing print/scan/copy actions. The class follows a verification-heavy pattern with dedicated verify methods for each screen state, uses explicit waits for UI elements, and provides granular control over printer management tasks. Notable patterns include serial number-based printer search, multi-step printer setup flow with instructions and confirmation screens, and detailed printer status monitoring including supplies levels.
